（summary / FAQ / 应用领域 / 名称）均已通过 LLM 翻译为中文，中文用户

隐私提示和 opt-out 环境变量；LLM 翻译的 prompt 已加固防御 prompt injection。

description:
Download global administrative boundary vector data (Shapefile / GeoJSON /
GeoPackage / TopoJSON) for any country or multi-country region. Backed by
geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0, default) with GADM 4.1 and Natural Earth as
fallbacks. Supports bbox clipping, multi-country merge, and a rich
metadata API (year, source, license, area, vertex count).

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release.

- Provides command-line tools to download global administrative boundaries in multiple formats (Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, TopoJSON).
- Supports country/region search, ISO/name resolution, bounding box clipping, and multi-country merges.
- Integrates geoBoundaries (default, CC BY 4.0), with GADM 4.1 and Natural Earth as fallbacks.
- Includes metadata API (year, source, license, area, vertex count) and caching mechanism.
- Offers extensive documentation and example usage.
